title: Grant, CAS, replay, and terminal enforcement
summary: Every effect is admitted by the authority against an immutable grant, exact expected state, replay nonce, and live attempt boundary.

assertions.description: One valid broker call under the exact grant and expected-state hash produces one receipt.
Replay, stale-state, out-of-scope, and mismatched-attempt calls fail closed before any durable or filesystem effect.
A terminal attempt can no longer exercise its grant even if the credential and nonce are replayed.
